summary: This Phase 3 study looks at how a combination of the drugs Liraglutide and Metformin affects weight loss, hormone levels, and pregnancy rates in women. The research focuses on female participants who have polycystic ovary syndrome, obesity, and infertility. Polycystic ovary syndrome is a common hormone disorder that affects women of reproductive age and can cause trouble getting pregnant. The trial plans to enroll 188 participants and is sponsored by Mỹ Đức Hospital.
